name: How does a garage conversion differ from a garage addition, and which is right for me?

mainEntity.name: How does a garage conversion differ from a garage addition, and which is right for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion repurposes an existing garage structure into a new living space, such as a home office or ADU, utilizing the existing footprint. A garage addition involves building entirely new square footage adjacent to or as an extension of your current garage or home. Choosing between a conversion and an addition depends on your specific needs, available space on your property, and budget. A conversion might be more cost-effective if the existing structure is sound, while an addition offers greater flexibility in design and size. We can assess your property and discuss both options during an initial consultation to determine the best approach for enhancing functionality and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion repurposes existing space, while an addition builds new square footage. The choice depends on your needs, available property space, and budget, with additions offering more design flexibility.
